about: r2 was closed, but a stray write put a colon after [AGENT] in its link line, which the settled form leaves out. The Edit guard raises link-line-invalid and close-invalid. The log gives the reason 'its link line wasn't in the settled form', then 'The request is open again.' act puts the request line back to its snapshot text and removes the link line, so the note matches its snapshot except r1's close; the second check is clean. r1 passed cleanly and goes under Done. Reading: an undone close is listed under Closes undone only, not also under Requests still open, whose reasons are failed, no findings, or the outcomes file refused.
